blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — All 29 dogs and cats dumped in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan, have been claimed by their respective owners, according to an animal rescue group. The deceased pets were reportedly brought to the Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium in Bacoor City, Cavite, but were later found inside sacks dumped in a vacant lot in Barangay Minuyan Proper, San Jose del Monte. “No furbabies left behind, all claimed by their owner,” the Luna and Furry Siblings Animal Rescue, which first raised the incident, wrote in a Facebook post on Sunday.
